title: Before you begin
steps: Block real time before Monday
Open a setup log and keep it open
Confirm you have all three API keys in hand
Know the shape of what you're building

title: 0 · Baseline machine
steps: Confirm Windows 11, 64-bit, and updated
Check whether your laptop is ARM-based
Free up disk space (25 GB or more)
Establish whether you can install software

title: 1 · Terminal and PowerShell
steps: Open Windows Terminal as your normal user
Check which PowerShell you're in
Allow scripts to run for your user account

title: 2 · winget, the package manager
steps: Confirm winget is present
Repair winget only if it's missing
Clear winget's first-run agreement prompt

title: 3 · Git for Windows
steps: Install Git
Close this terminal and open a new one
Verify Git and locate Git Bash

title: 4 · Node.js and Python
steps: Install Node.js LTS — the suffix matters
Install Python
Close this terminal and open a new one
Verify Node, npm, and Python
Make sure "python" is the real Python

title: 5 · Your three API keys
steps: Read the keys reference first
Set OPENAI_API_KEY
Set XAI_API_KEY
Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Verify all three in a brand-new window

title: 6 · Your smoke folder
steps: Create the folder every tool will write into
Understand why a file on disk is the standard

title: 7 · Codex — your home for the week
steps: Install the ChatGPT desktop app
Sign in with your API key
Confirm you're on the key, not an account
Lock the app to API-key sign-in
Open your smoke folder as a project
Set the permission mode
Write proof: from-codex.txt
Know what your key does and doesn't buy

title: 8 · OpenCode — your second engine
steps: Know what OpenCode is for
Get the version staff pinned for your cohort
Install OpenCode
New terminal, then verify OpenCode
Confirm OpenCode sees your xAI key
Keep this engine independent
Write proof: from-opencode.txt

title: 9 · Pi — the minimal harness
steps: Know what Pi is for
Install Pi
New terminal, then verify Pi
Write proof: from-pi.txt
Prove Pi can reach a shell

title: 10 · goose — recipe, tools, mode, schedule
steps: Know what goose is for
Do not install goose with winget
Turn off the Windows keyring first
Tell goose which provider and model to use
Install the goose command-line tool
Add goose to your PATH
Verify goose and check what it sees
Write proof: from-goose.txt

title: 11 · Obsidian
steps: Install Obsidian
Create a vault and confirm it opens

title: 12 · n8n
steps: Re-check your Node version first
Install n8n
Start n8n once and open the editor
Create the local owner account, and skip the licence offer
Learn how to stop it

title: 13 · Course repo and operator pack
steps: Clone the course repository
Copy the operator templates into your working project
Run the course site locally
Protect your keys before your first commit

title: 14 · Claude Code — optional third engine
steps: Decide whether to install it
Install Claude Code and prove it writes

title: 15 · Pack for Monday
steps: Confirm all four required files exist together
Close the setup log honestly
Pack for Monday clinic

steps: "is not recognized" after a successful install

"running scripts is disabled on this system"
